Rewrote `mergeRanges` in `ranges.mjs`:

- **Validation**: throws `TypeError` if input isn't an array, if an element isn't a 2-element array, if bounds aren't safe integers, or if `start > end`.
- **No mutation**: input pairs are copied into fresh `[start, end]` arrays before sorting, so neither the input array nor its pairs are touched.
- **Sorting**: by start, then end.
- **Merging**: merges when `start <= last[1] + 1` (overlap or adjacent integers); contained intervals never shorten the current interval since the end only grows when `end > last[1]`.
- **Output**: fresh result array of fresh pair arrays, sorted by start; empty input returns `[]`.
- Named export preserved.

No tests were run (no execution tool available); correctness was verified by reading the code only.
